statement: Pt. Leo Estate is planted to 50 acres of vines.
note: Attached because the vineyard acreage and the sculpture park acreage are routinely conflated into a single estate figure, which is the confusion corrected in this corpus earlier today. Keeping the two as separate claims is what stops them recombining. Authored by hand for the PI-005 Stage 2 pilot on the Pt. Leo Estate sculpture park cluster. Sources were read on 2026-09-13; see ops/reports/claims/2026-09-13-pilot-pt-leo-sculpture-park.md.
